name: rot-dtd-commander
description: RoT DtD Commander: 131 Claude Code commands, 22 skills and 5 agents that carry their own DTD grammar and trust boundary, the creator kit (prompt, meta-prompt, skill, hook, command, subagent, plan, MCP, workflow, task, filetype and dork creators), a guided NPX installer into ~/.claude, the Adiutor Stop-hook doctor that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE that produced it, the AI_SLOP gate on five spots when armed, and the codebase growth family that walks any codebase and names the release its findings amount to.

scripts.gate: node checker/gate-sync.mjs && npm run build:check && npm run check && node checker/heading-sweep.mjs --check && node checker/frontmatter-sweep.mjs --check && npm run controls && node checker/contract-audit.mjs && bash checker/checker-controls.sh && npm run sweep && npm run controls:ordinals && npm run controls:slop && npm run controls:ceiling && npm run controls:form && npm run controls:args && npm run controls:schematic && npm run controls:workflow && npm run controls:task && npm run controls:record && npm run controls:license && npm run controls:scratch && npm run controls:amplify && npm run controls:regression && npm run sweep:engines && npm run sweep:about && npm run sweep:lists && npm run sweep:reach && npm run controls:list && npm run controls:starlist && npm run sweep:slop && npm run sweep:prose && npm run sweep:tracked && npm run sweep:index && npm run sweep:glossary && npm run controls:glossary && npm run sweep:regression && npm run sweep:counts && node checker/release-notes.mjs --versions && node checker/release-notes.mjs --controls
scripts.sweep:regression: node lib/regression.mjs claims && node lib/regression.mjs retenue && node lib/regression.mjs unreached
scripts.sweep:slop: node lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep src/commands src/skills src/agents --max 0 && node lib/ai-slop.mjs dtd/ladder.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep artifacts/amplify-codebase
scripts.sweep:prose: node lib/ai-slop.mjs README.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs CHANGELOG.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs NOTICE.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs SECURITY.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs PRIVACY.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs RELEASE.md
